ITEMS.name: Economy chamber
ITEMS.desc: Passive cooling. Two heat alarms need a sensor or a careful response.

ITEMS.name: Vanguard chamber
ITEMS.desc: Active climate control. 500 W, not 800 W. Does not guarantee biological survival.

ITEMS.name: Solar wings
ITEMS.desc: Adds 400 W at departure, 340 W under the simplified arrival factor. Heavy but useful.

ITEMS.name: Thermal sensor
ITEMS.desc: Detects heat alarms; controller responds automatically, using 10 W extra per alarm.

ITEMS.name: Repair toolkit
ITEMS.desc: Two autonomous repair actions for heat or mechanical incidents.

ITEMS.name: High-gain antenna
ITEMS.desc: Sends up to 64 MB per 30 days. Does not change the speed of light.

ITEMS.name: Backup link
ITEMS.desc: Sends 16 MB per 30 days. Automatically handles a signal incident.

ITEMS.name: Radiation dosimeter
ITEMS.desc: Adds 8 MB of observations per 30 days. Measures radiation; provides no shielding.

LAUNCHERS.name: Scout
LAUNCHERS.desc: Low-cost biological survey. Small payload; best with the Economy chamber.

LAUNCHERS.name: Aurelia
LAUNCHERS.desc: Balanced payload and bus. Vanguard needs solar wings and careful instruments.

LAUNCHERS.name: Atlaswing
LAUNCHERS.desc: Higher capacity and manoeuvre margin; expensive, with higher bus consumption.

ROUTES.name: A little sooner
ROUTES.desc: Fast transfer · 16 fewer days of exposure.
